info.title: KontentModelGenerator
info.description: CLI tool that generates modern record-based C# models from your Kontent.ai content types for use with the Kontent.ai Delivery SDK for .NET (v19+). Install as a global or local .NET tool: `dotnet tool install -g Kontent.Ai.ModelGenerator`. See the README for usage.
